name: Calif Verse
memo: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Californication: verse/intro. Clean-edge Strat-style tone with a touch of chorus and room; melodic and open.

band.style_feel: slow, spacious mid-tempo groove, soft kick pattern and light hi-hat in the verses, bigger backbeat in the chorus
parts: Part A: intro and verse - sparse drums, Am F groove
Part B: chorus - full band, adds C G Dm
Part C: interlude - back to Am F, quiet and open
Part D: solo - brighter section, full band
band.tips: Sources disagree on tempo (about 95-97 BPM is the most common reading), so check it against the recording before the Trio+ learns. Play the intro riff cleanly for 2 bars, then keep strumming steady.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
how: Keep your guitar in standard tuning (E A D G B E).
whammy.tips: No pitch effect or alternate tuning is documented for this song.

originals.guitar: 1957 Gretsch White Falcon (one source credits it for the main riff)

guitar.position: neck or middle pickup for the verses, bridge pickup for the chorus; volume full, tone around 7
guitar.tone_notes: Clear single-coil tone with a little chorus. A humbucker guitar will sound thicker: roll back the tone knob and pick the neck pickup for the verses.

name: Calif Chorus
memo: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Californication: chorus and solo. Crunch with a fuzz-style lift and a little echo.
